title: Lila Counts in the Garden
lyrics: One bright flower, two orange carrots, three green leaves.

characters.name: Lila
characters.description: A curious ladybug who helps children count garden objects.
characters.appearance: A small round red ladybug with black spots and large kind eyes.

scenes.narration: Lila finds one bright yellow flower and happily counts one.
scenes.visual_description: Lila stands beside one large yellow flower on a colorful garden path.

location.name: flower garden
location.description: A cheerful preschool garden with one large yellow flower.

camera.description: A slow stable view follows Lila toward the flower.

scenes.narration: Lila finds two orange carrots and counts one, two.
scenes.visual_description: Lila points toward two orange carrots growing beside green leaves.

location.name: vegetable garden
location.description: A tidy preschool vegetable patch with two orange carrots.

camera.description: A gentle stable pan reveals both carrots and Lila waving.
